newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse consolidates rising trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse consolidates rising trend.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse ended the week higher on Friday boosted by blue chips, including the company with the largest market capitalisation, ONA Group, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 414.34 points, up from 402.56 last week.
ONA Group closed at 412 dirhams, up two dirhams compared with last Friday.
"As was expected ONA stock resumed its upward trend due mainly to forecasts of positive consolidated results ahead," a Casablanca-based market analyst said.

The share value was also pushed up by increasing interest of investors in ONA stock after the recent purchase of four mines at a total of $75 million. The bourse volume jumped to 138.1 million dirhams from 17.08 million a week earlier, due mainly to trading in Samir refinery shares, a bourse official said.
Large blocks of more than 120,000 shares of SAMIR exchanged hands over the counter on Friday, stockbrokers said.
The refinery's stock rose to 245 dirhams from 243 dirhams the previous week.
Wafabank, one the main market capitalisations, rose 21 dirhams to close at 453 dirhams compared with last Friday.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, which has interests in more than 40 companies, remained stable at 575 dirhams, traders said.
Credit Eqdom EQDOM.CS, the largest consumer credit company, continued its rise to close at 930 dirhams, up from 866 dirhams on last Friday.
